mentions.name: SalesFighter
mentions.description: A Duolingo-style app for learning the skills of good salespeople, gamified so practice feels fun rather than a basic quiz workflow; it has evolved to also work as an evaluation benchmark for sales agents.
mentions.problem: Sales skills are hard to pick up without engaging practice; making it feel fun versus a basic quiz workflow is the hardest part.
mentions.audience: Self-teaching product manager practicing sales skills
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building a “Duolingo for sales” to try to teach myself more. it’s started to morph a bit into an eval benchmark for sales agents

evidence.value: I’ve been building a “Duolingo for sales” to try to teach myself more. it’s started to morph a bit into an eval benchmark for sales agents
